notes: ADR-063 Q4-DS4-RACE (#667) hf2q arm on ds4's DeepSeek-V4 Flash 0731 file (antirez/deepseek-v4-gguf rev f71f23d5, 86,720,111,488 bytes, sha256 ca22ae2f838e14077c22bc1c1417b71b45b5e5a3687bd96c2ac6e17fdb6261c0), served through ADR-066 N-IQ2XXS (IQ2_XXS routed gate/up, Q2_K down, Q8_0 shared experts, F16 compressor/indexer/HC projections and token_embd, F16 router). It is a benchmark comparison artifact, not a substitute for hf2q conversion (ADR-063 Q4-DS4). Copy of deepseek4.json: only MODEL, MODEL_SHA256, MODEL_ID and workload.id differ.

Admission is a fresh calibration (docs/research/adr066-iq2xxs-subset-design.md section 7.3): run q5_calibration.py on this case without --admission-receipt. The 2026-10-30 DeepSeek-V4 calibration receipt (hf2q's own 107.4 GB artifact) does not transfer: the hf2q weights here are 86.7 GB.

MODEL_SHA256 is operator-provided and not hashed inline (q5_artifacts); no sidecar receipt accompanies the model file. Its verification is the section 6.1 T2 full-file digest (scripts/four_agent/ds4_file_digest.py), whose receipt will live at /Users/robert/.local/state/hf2q/v0130/q4-ds4-race/t2-digest.json (not written yet); campaign reports cite it.
Derived from: DeepSeek-V4 runner: current-port balanced series manifest and launcher (--ctx 262144, 8 GiB shared KV budget).
Override any variable with HF2Q_Q5_<NAME>; null variables are required. See scripts/four_agent/README.md.

The client is the checked-in canonical four-agent coding workload. Q5 requires the largest declared workload: if the operator declares a larger one (e.g. largest prompt or tool result), copy this case and replace client.argv.

MAX_COMPRESSOR_USED_GIB=16: the launcher refuses before load when the compressor holds more than MAX_COMPRESSOR_USED_GIB (default 8). The first a1 attempt (a1-20261030T042017Z) was refused for 'compressor use exceeds 8 GiB'. The dedicated host's idle baseline compressor is 9.3-10.0 GiB (QE verdict; final receipt baseline.compressor_bytes 10002579456). 16 GiB admits that measured baseline with ~6 GiB headroom while still refusing a compressor at twice the launcher default. The launcher's swap (8 GiB) and other-process (8 GiB) refusals stay active. The Q5 live stops (critical pressure, swap +512 MiB, Free+cached < 2 GiB, footprint cap) govern the run.
Scope: the canonical C262144 coding workload only (about 2.3k prompt tokens per slot, no demand-grown cache migration). Calibrate any deeper DeepSeek-V4 workload separately.

LOG_FILTER (empty default: the launcher keeps -v, and RUST_LOG below stays ignored) is the ADR-063 S3 trace arm: HF2Q_Q5_LOG_FILTER='hf2q=info,mlx_native=info,hf2q::serve::api::engine_deepseek4::progress=debug' replaces -v with RUST_LOG=LOG_FILTER, adding the per-turn joint decode lines for cancel_smoke.py widths.

Kill-switch arms of the three DeepSeek-V4 default routes (v0.1.30, ADR-063 Q4-DS4-RACE): HF2Q_Q5_DEEPSEEK_ROW_EXACT_MATVEC=0, HF2Q_Q5_DEEPSEEK_TAIL_ROWS_STEP=0 and HF2Q_Q5_DEEPSEEK_BATCHED_ATTN_CORES=0 are passed to the server as HF2Q_DEEPSEEK_ROW_EXACT_MATVEC, HF2Q_DEEPSEEK_TAIL_ROWS_STEP and HF2Q_DEEPSEEK_BATCHED_ATTN_CORES; 1 selects the route explicitly. The empty defaults export nothing, so the server runs the hf2q defaults (all three on); a binary older than v0.1.30 then runs them off. Use a distinct --output per arm.
